items.name: At the Salvager's Fire: one NPC, salvage topic

data.name: At the Salvager's Fire
data.description: The salvager keeps her fire on the shore below the Wreck (sector 210). Sit with her and ask about getting aboard, the charts, the chests, the deep, the Haul, salvage, trading or the watch log.
data.successDescription: The fire's there when you need it.

objectives.description:
The Ghost Ship hung over this coast longer than anyone's grandmother could remember. Now she has come down.

A salvager mends a net by a driftwood fire below the wreck. "Another one come to pick her bones. Sit, then. Ask."

She nods at a board of driftwood where she pins what the sea gives back. "Ask what you came to ask."

Pick a topic. You can come back to this board after each answer.

nextObjectiveId.text: How do I get aboard her?
What do you want with salvage?
Can I trade what I find?

objectives.description:
"Nobody goes aboard alone and comes back. Go in threes."

She is ashore Friday to Sunday, every weekend. The Wreck is a party dungeon in sector 210. It takes exactly 3 players, and a run lasts up to an hour.

"She broke in two. The near half is faded and gentler. The far half still remembers every order."

The Faded Skyglass Wreck (sector 210, 16/6) opens at level 30. The Skyglass Wreck (15/6) is the endgame hull and opens at level 80.

"No crew, and not yet 80? Wreckage washes off the near half every tide. I'll show you the Driftline. It's sized to whoever walks it."

The Driftline is for one player, levels 30 to 80. The salvager hands out its way in once Wreck Sighted is done.

"Coin, stores and paper. Charts, wet ones, drawn by the crew themselves."

Every clear pays ryo, EXP and Wreck Salvage, and can drop charts. The endgame hull also drops the rarer charts, ledger pages, the Lantern and a shard.

"Each chart is the way into one corner of her, and she doesn't hold still, so it's good once."

Take a chart to the Battle Arena and run it alone; claim any waiting reward first. The chart is spent when the run starts. Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, and a lost fight ends the run.

"The low-tide charts and the rosters take you to the lower decks. Down there are the crew's own charts: what they buried, the works, the archive, the helm. Those lead to the places the crew sealed shut."

Most runs can drop the next chart down, or trade salvage for one. The endgame Wreck and Archive Chart Cases also drop the Captain's Watch chart.

nextObjectiveId.text: What do I get for winning?

objectives.description:
"Win, and the crew lets you choose what to carry out."

A winning ending lets you pick one reward from a short list and pays EXP. Some runs end in a last room: leave with what you hold, or press on for more and keep only that if you lose. Any other loss pays nothing. Every chart shows its difficulty in stars.

"The crew sealed their crates well. Prying them open is half the fun."

A Skyglass Coffer holds Filament, Serum, a Crown Fragment or, rarely, the Skyglass Katana. A Sealed Treasury holds ryo, Imperial Gold, Rare Jewels and Unobtanium. Crown's Hoard holds a Coffer, a Treasury and a Skyglass Token. Unmarked Cargo could be anything.

"Pills, kunai, dried fish. They ate better than we do."

Medicine Inro: healing and chakra pills. Sage's Strongbox: battle potions and rarer pills. Elemental Tool Pouch: Elemental Kunai and tools. Galley Stores: 2,000 EXP for an eligible active pet. Little Horror's Jar, a rare drop from the endgame Wreck, is the event's pet.

"The glass itself is worth more than anything they packed, if you know how to work it."

12 Skyglass Filament craft a Skyglass Crystal, and 5 Fragments of the Skyglass Crown craft The Skyglass Crown. Both need a crafting rank; without one, trade them to someone who has it.

"Some doors the crew sealed. The Reliquary Seal opens the reliquary. The Last Heading takes you back to the night she fell."

These are the Epic runs, The Sealed Reliquary and The Fall. Their charts drop from the Archive and the Captain's Watch, and the salvager trades one a week.

"Soak a sealed chart in Core Rot and the rot remembers the place worse."

Use an Epic chart from your inventory with 3 Core Rot, then win one fight. You get the tainted chart: a harder run where you pick 2 rewards. Lose, and the chart comes back but the Rot is spent. Core Rot drops from the endgame Wreck, the low-tide runs, The Fall and the tainted runs.

"Some come back from the deep with a lantern that won't go out. It points at the mountain, at Crownhold, the castle she sailed from. Someone still gives orders there."

A Lastlight Lantern opens Crownhold. It drops from the Epic and tainted runs and rarely from the endgame Wreck, and from level 80 the salvager trades one a week.

"Some bring back a ledger page or a stores list and go after holds no chart shows. They come back heavy, or not at all."

A page opens The Haul: up to 5 steps of crate, locker or cut through. Deeper, bigger chests of profession materials. Leave after any step to keep them; lose a fight and you keep nothing. Pages drop from the endgame Wreck and the Rare runs.

"Bring me what you pull off her. Brass, glass, rope. I pay in charts."

Every Skyglass win pays Wreck Salvage: Wreck clears, chart runs and watch log orders. It can't be traded. Bring it to her and trade it for charts.

"Four pieces for a deck chart. Ten for one from the hold. The sealed charts and the Lantern, once a week."

Each talk with her on the map uses one daily NPC encounter and offers her fire or a trade. Deck charts 4 (Genin), hold charts 10 (Jonin), a sealed chart 20 weekly, the Lantern 30 weekly (level 80). Back out and she returns the salvage.

"What you can't use, trade. Every chart and every shard has a buyer."

Charts, Core Rot, Haul pages, shards and Skyglass Tokens can be traded. Crown's Hoard, Unmarked Cargo, Wreck Salvage, the Haul's chests and some once-only rewards cannot.

"The crew's colours still take to steel."

A Skyglass Token unlocks one Skyglass skin, once, on a weapon you already own: Aetherion, Thornsilver, Night's Testament, Stormrender, Oathbinder, Ink of the Void, The Unwritten, Gaea's Embrace, Warden's Bracers, Eclipsed Dawnblade, Zephyr's Whisper or Yuki's Frostbite. A boss's own token unlocks that boss's skin.

"I keep their watch log. It washes up a page at a time. I dry one each weekend and pin it up in the Administration Building."

A new page goes up each weekend in your village's Administration Building; Wake Island has one too, nearest the Wreck. Take it first: only what you do while you carry it counts.

"One watch's orders. Lately the name at the top isn't one of theirs."

Do the orders in any order and claim each reward from your Logbook. Finish them all for the page's last reward. The page closes Tuesday 00:00 UTC (Monday 6 PM Central).
Back to the fire.
She goes back to her net. "The fire's here. So is she."
You leave the fire.
